description: Sign a membership's exact terms — the only proof of consent: your Ed25519 signature over membership_statement for a fresh single-use nonce. Active once both parties have signed (active:true). The broker never holds either key, so it can never sign for a party. 403 on a bad signature or nonce, 404 unknown membership. Old name: sign_contract / POST /contracts/:id/sign.

agent_id.description: the signer: the company or the member

nonce.description: the nonce the statement was built with

signature.description: hex Ed25519 signature of the statement

name: sign_membership
title: Sign membership
